definition: προσ-τάσσω  [in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] __1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to.  __2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: Luk.5:14; with dative of person(s), Mat.1:24; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.8:4, Mrk.1:44; with accusative and inf., Act.10:48; pass., Act.10:33 17:26.† (AS)
